'''Edward Rivas LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Edward Rivas]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-21275">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21275 DeckTech post 21275], DeckTech (Edward "Devil Dog" Rivas, 7 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21275/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Edward Rivas]]
* '''Published:''' 7 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif|label=We'll Handle This}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WHT Rivas LS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Combat with jedi mains

== Original post ==

'''Lil' @#$%   the light side lightsaber combat deck'''
* '''Author:''' Edward "Devil Dog" Rivas
* '''Published:''' February 7, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Combat with jedi mains

=== Strategy ===

All You  have to do is just set up sop on the sites that you have to star with then take the battle to them just becarful about who yo uplay especially when they play Sidious.
